dir.create("data")
dir.create("data/linelists")
install.packages("rio")     # universal import/export tool
install.packages("here")    # builds reliable file paths
install.packages("pacman")  # lets you load multiple packages in one line (used later)
library(rio)
library(here)
here()
linelist <- import(here("data", "linelists", "linelist_cleaned.xlsx"))
head(linelist)
gss <- import(here("data", "GSSsubset.csv"))
head(gss)
my_data <- import(here("data", "linelists", "linelist_cleaned.xlsx"), which = "Sheet1")
my_data <- import(here("data", "linelists", "linelist_cleaned.xlsx"), which = "linelist")
readxl::excel_sheets(here("data", "linelists", "lmy_data <- import(here("data", "linelists", "linelist_cleaned.xlsx"), which = "Sheet 1")inelist_cleaned.xlsx"))
head(my_data)
linelist <- import(here("data", "linelists", "linelist_cleaned.xlsx"), na = c("99", "Missing", ""))
linelist_raw <- import(here("data", "linelists", "linelist_cleaned.xlsx"), skip = 1)
export(linelist, here("data", "clean_linelist.xlsx"))   # save as Excel
export(linelist, here("data", "clean_linelist.csv"))    # save as CSV
export(linelist, here("data", "clean_linelist.rds"))    # save as R's own format
linelist2 <- import(here("data", "clean_linelist.rds"))
head(linelist2)
linelist2 <- import(here("data", "clean_linelist.rds"), trust = FALSE)
# create a fake messy file to practice on
messy <- data.frame(
  age = c("Age in years", "34", "51", "22"),
  sex = c("Patient sex", "Male", "Female", "Male")
)
export(messy, here("data", "messy_example.csv"))
view(messy)
bad_import <- import(here("data", "messy_example.csv"))
bad_import
library(dplyr)
# 1. Import once just to grab the real column names
real_names <- import(here("data", "messy_example.csv")) %>% names()
real_names

# 2. Import again, skipping the messy second row, then reapply names
clean_import <- import(here("data", "messy_example.csv"), skip = 1, col.names = real_names)
clean_import
library(tibble)

manual_entry <- tribble(
  ~patient_id, ~age, ~outcome,
  1,           34,   "Recovered",
  2,           51,   "Died",
  3,           22,   "Recovered"
)
manual_entry
patient_id <- c(1, 2, 3)
age        <- c(34, 51, 22)
outcome    <- c("Recovered", "Died", "Recovered")

manual_entry2 <- data.frame(patient_id, age, outcome)
manual_entry2
